title: 云南大学 Wang 等在 GRL 发表 Lake Baikal 恢复研究
originalTitle: World's largest freshwater lake is recovering after decades of decline
summary: 云南大学 Wang 等在《Geophysical Research Letters》发表研究，揭示 Lake Baikal 恢复与北极变暖放缓及海洋温度变化相关。
